notes.title: New Release Date & Steam Next Fest Announcement!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][p]We’ve made a big decision: the demo for [b]Fields of Fortune[/b] is being [b]delayed one final time[/b], now launching on [b]October 13, 2025[/b].[/p][p]That’s right – we’re joining [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]!
It’s the perfect chance to share our cozy farming game with more players, and to show you the best possible version of our demo. 💛[/p][p]We know many of you were looking forward to July 15 – and we’re truly sorry for the extra wait.
But we believe this step will make the demo [b]sharper, smoother and more visible[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Why the change?[/h3][p]🔹 Steam Next Fest brings more visibility & community reach
🔹 We’re using the time for polish and [b]smarter automation systems[/b]
🔹 The new timing avoids overlap with major releases & the Summer Sale[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌱 What to expect:[/h3][p]– A cozy farming sim with [b]true automation mechanics[/b]
– New [b]fishing system[/b], events & clever farm workflows
– Demo playable for the first time starting [b]October 13, 2025[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611226/5b56da3f890bd4253b9ddb3012f73a2166b3b990.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you so much for your understanding, patience and support!
👉 [b]Add Fields of Fortune to your wishlist[/b] so you don’t miss the Steam Next Fest demo drop![/p][p]We can’t wait to welcome you to the fields this October.[/p][p]– The Fields of Fortune Team 🌾[/p]

notes.title: 🌾 Release Date Update – Fields of Fortune Demo 🌾
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2][h3]We originally planned to release the [i]Fields of Fortune[/i] demo on [b]June 20th[/b]. However, with Mojang's major Minecraft update landing on [b]June 17th[/b], we’ve decided to give our cozy farming game a little more breathing room.[/h3][p][/p][h3]🎯 [b]New Release Date: July 15th, 2025[/b][/h3][p]By then, the big wave of AAA updates and the Steam Summer Sale will be over – and we believe that gives [i]Fields of Fortune[/i] a much better chance to reach you without getting lost in the crowd.[/p][p]We know delays aren’t fun, but we’re using this extra time to make the demo even smoother and more polished for you.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎣 Bonus Sneak Peek: [b]Fishing is in![/b][/h3][p]That’s right – we’ve just added fishing to the game! Here’s a little look at it in action:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611226/5b56da3f890bd4253b9ddb3012f73a2166b3b990.gif"][/img][/p][p]Small cozy features like this are exactly what we’re focusing on in the final stretch – and [b]fishing is only the beginning[/b].[/p][p]We're actively working on improving the system, and we’ve got a lot planned for it – from interactions to surprises and more depth overall. 🎏
So stay tuned – this little fishing rod still has big plans![/p][p][/p][p]💚 Thank you so much for your patience and support! We can’t wait to welcome you to the fields soon.[/p][p]👉 [b]Wishlist now[/b] to get notified when the demo drops, and stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: 📰 Demo Update: New Language, More Content & A Head Start into Automation!
notes.content:
[p]🔧 [i]The demo just got bigger – more content, new languages and a faster start into automation![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611226/7b7b3c30a5ce99cd7e409c2b87d3dcfdefbe4b04.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]We’ve just pushed a big update to the demo – and it brings us one step closer to release.[/p][h3]✨ [b]What’s new?[/b][/h3][p]🌍 [b]Now available in German & English[/b]
You can now play the demo in either English or German. Choose your language at launch and dive in![/p][p]📦 [b]Expanded demo content[/b]
The demo no longer stops at the prologue – after that, you now get [b]30 minutes of unrestricted access to the main game[/b]. It’s a perfect chance to explore the gameplay systems and progression.[/p][p]🎁 [b]Starter pack for automation[/b]
Right after the prologue, you’ll receive a gift package with [b]automation devices[/b] – so you can jump straight into building and optimizing![/p][hr][/hr][p]💬 Let us know what language you'd like to see next – and what features you’re most curious about.[/p][p]🎯 The full demo release is just around the corner – wishlist the game and stay tuned for more updates![/p][p]Thanks so much for your support! 🙌[/p]

🌍 [b]Now available in German & English[/b]
You can now play the demo in either English or German. Choose your language at launch and dive in!

📦 [b]Expanded demo content[/b]
The demo no longer stops at the prologue – after that, you now get [b]30 minutes of unrestricted access to the main game[/b]. It’s a perfect chance to explore the gameplay systems and progression.

🎁 [b]Starter pack for automation[/b]
Right after the prologue, you’ll receive a gift package with [b]automation devices[/b] – so you can jump straight into building and optimizing!
